title: Literature-bound He-Hantush two-layer integrated Richards comparator
purpose: Test whether the published first-order, layer-averaged two-layer Richards formulation of He et al. (2021), adapted only at the fixed-depth prescribed-pressure lower boundary by retaining its pre-water-table Darcy/Taylor equations, provides a stronger B01 cost-fidelity candidate than the clean-sheet D5-D8 reductions and the R2 coarse-Richards comparator.

primary.citation: He, J., Hantush, M.M., Kalin, L., Rezaeianzadeh, M., Isik, S. (2021). A two-layer numerical model of soil moisture dynamics: Model development. Journal of Hydrology 602, 126797.

assessment.citation: He, J., Hantush, M.M., Kalin, L., Isik, S. (2022). Two-Layer numerical model of soil moisture dynamics: Model assessment and Bayesian uncertainty estimation. Journal of Hydrology 613, 128327.
assessment.role: external evidence on strengths, limitations and layer-thickness sensitivity; not calibration authority for B01

scientific_role.statement: D9 evaluates an existing published reduction before inventing a new custom state/segmentation architecture.

predecessor_evidence.D5: Two dynamic layer averages with harmonic-conductivity instantaneous Darcy closure are robust but dominated by R2.
predecessor_evidence.D7: One-state quasi-steady profile manifold is robust but dominated by R2.
predecessor_evidence.D8: Two dynamic quasi-steady composite segments improve monotonically over D5/D7, especially upper-zone storage, but remain dominated by R2; lower-zone exchange remains limiting.
predecessor_evidence.implication: A published first-order integrated-Richards closure must be tested before a custom QS3 or lag state is justified.

constitutive_identity.pressure_variable: psi = -h > 0 for unsaturated pressure head h<0

exact_published_core.Kbar_i: K(theta_bar_i), as the paper's first-order approximation to layer-average K
exact_published_core.psibar_i: psi(theta_bar_i), as used by the published layer-average constitutive closure
balances: (H-h)*dtheta2/dt = q1-q2 because H is fixed in the D9 SWAP comparator

prescribed_flux.rule: q2 equals the declared downward-positive physical bottom flux
prescribed_flux.publication_relation: compatible with the ODE balance; no extra closure needed

prescribed_pressure_head.derivation: Retain published Eq. 28 q=K*dpsi/dz+K and Eq. 30 dpsi/dz≈2*(psi_b-psibar2)/(H-h), but do not apply the water-table-only Eq. 29 specialization K_b=Ks.
prescribed_pressure_head.K_bottom: K(theta(psi_b)) from the same B01 Van Genuchten/Mualem law
prescribed_pressure_head.claim_boundary: This pressure-boundary expression is literature-derived but was not the zero-pressure water-table special case used in the paper's main validation.

top_boundary.rule: q0 is the externally declared downward-positive forcing flux from the frozen B01 workload.
top_boundary.no_infiltration_capacity_or_ET_submodel: D9 isolates the unsaturated-zone reduction; no new surface or ET physics is introduced.

time_integration.convergence: absolute change in each layer-average theta <= 0.0001, matching the published model-evaluation setting
time_integration.maximum_iteration_role: execution safety only; failure at 100 is fail-closed and does not authorize tolerance or timestep retuning

seed.initial_bottom_pressure_head: h(theta0) for equilibrium control when pressure mode is used
seed.seed_rule: two intervals using the same iterative Heun scheme and equilibrium prescribed top/bottom flux; any drift and mass residual are reported

integrity: theta_r < theta_bar_i < theta_s for both layers at every published state and every corrector iterate used for flux evaluation
all psi, K and fluxes finite
absolute total transaction mass residual <=1e-12 cm
no clipping, fallback, adaptive substeps or hidden correction

positive_rule: and balance view beats/equal R2 on both total-storage and cumulative-bottom-exchange RMSE
or transient view beats/equal R2 on bottom-flux RMSE and sign-error count

purpose_dependent_boundary.LONG_TERM_REGIONAL_WATER_BALANCE: D9 can retain a literature-bound architecture candidate only; no application acceptance.
purpose_dependent_boundary.GROUNDWATER_COUPLED_MANY_COLUMN: May remain candidate if lower-boundary behavior is competitive; live coupling remains separate.

successor_logic.if_positive: Retain the literature-bound model for later purpose-specific validation and same-runtime cost-fidelity qualification before inventing a custom successor.
successor_logic.if_negative: Close the faithful first-order two-layer family for the exposed B01 hydraulic problem; only then consider a custom third lower-zone segment, higher-order correction, or explicit lag state.
successor_logic.if_integrity_fails: Close D9 without changing epsilon, time step, layer split or boundary formula.
